content.comment_body: The program was removed from my [product_name] with [article_no]. I tried using a demo version, but it does not work with the controller. I need the full version of the software.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Please note, this is an English-speaking forum; kindly use English for future posts. The demo version of [product_name] does not allow communication with the controller. If you require the full version with all features, you will need to purchase a licensed version.

analysis.insight_summary: The user tried a demo version of [product_name] to connect with their [product_name] controller ([article_no]), but the demo does not permit this functionality. Another user clarified that only a licensed full version enables full communication. This restriction limits users' ability to test or operate hardware without buying a license.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to connect to the [product_name] controller using the software, ideally through a version that is not restricted as a demo and allows full communication.
